title: retire-alias request
description: Fields travel in params (rule 9). Request headers: team (decimal team_id of the causing message, or admin), request_id. Operator headers grant nothing on service subjects. Only caller: model-registry. operator_id is the archiving operator, recorded in the per-Flow audit messages. Reply: status 204 with empty body, or 409 model_last_in_flow with the error body plus flows. A repeated retirement of a retired alias is 204.
